resources.string: Send one handled test exception without crashing the app. Requires Anonymous usage data to be enabled. This checks the existing SDK session without reinitializing it.
Not sent: enable Anonymous usage data in Settings first.
Not supported: Sentry KMP 0.24.0 uses no-op implementations on Web JS and Wasm. Browser collection requires a separate Sentry JavaScript SDK integration.
Not sent: Sentry is not enabled. Wait for startup to finish and retry. If this persists, check initialization logs and the build DSN.
No event ID returned. The SDK did not accept the event; check SDK configuration and logs.
The test could not complete. Check settings access and SDK logs.
Submitted to SDK. Event ID: %1$s\n\nKeep the app open and search for this ID in Sentry. An event ID does not confirm delivery. You can also filter by showcase.test:true and showcase.platform.
